Definition: from G5426; mental action or activity, i.e. intellectual or moral insight:--prudence, wisdom.
BiblicalUsage: Phronesis is prudence, insight, mental action, and it appears twice. Paul says God has abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence, and the angel says John the Baptist will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe prudence is wisdom at work: God abounds toward us in it, and John's preaching turns the disobedient toward the wisdom of the just.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
